name: en_to_japanese_words
description: Few-shot English->Japanese single-word translation. Control: same format, English->English copy.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
D=[("dog","犬"),("cat","猫"),("house","家"),("water","水"),("bread","パン"),("book","本"),("tree","木"),("sun","太陽"),("moon","月"),("city","都市"),("car","車"),("friend","友達"),("night","夜"),("red","赤"),("black","黒"),("white","白"),("woman","女性"),("man","男性"),("child","子供"),("king","王"),("time","時間"),("world","世界"),("school","学校"),("door","ドア"),("window","窓"),("table","テーブル"),("chair","椅子"),("milk","牛乳"),("apple","りんご"),("fish","魚"),("bird","鳥"),("horse","馬"),("sea","海"),("mountain","山"),("river","川"),("fire","火"),("hand","手"),("head","頭"),("heart","心"),("eye","目"),("money","お金"),("work","仕事"),("love","愛"),("street","通り"),("week","週"),("year","年"),("morning","朝"),("summer","夏"),("winter","冬"),("cheese","チーズ"),("garden","庭"),("kitchen","台所"),("flower","花"),("rain","雨"),("snow","雪"),("wind","風"),("egg","卵"),("key","鍵"),("blue","青"),("teacher","先生"),("doctor","医者"),("computer","コンピューター"),("phone","電話"),("tea","お茶"),("rice","ご飯"),("country","国"),("station","駅"),("hospital","病院"),("student","学生"),("music","音楽")]
items=[];control=[]
for t in D:
    shots=random.sample([d for d in D if d is not t],3)
    items.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nJapanese: {s[1]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nJapanese:","answer":" "+t[1]})
    control.append({"prompt":"".join(f"English: {s[0]}\nEnglish: {s[0]}\n\n" for s in shots)+f"English: {t[0]}\nEnglish:","answer":" "+t[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open("/work/skill.json","w"),ensure_ascii=False)
